display_name: ACS implied aggregate mortgage debt proxy
definition: Constructed proxy for aggregate outstanding mortgage debt inferred from ACS B25106 owner income/cost-burden bins, ACS B25081 owner-with-mortgage counts, and Freddie Mac rate assumptions.
transformation: Allocate B25081 owner-with-mortgage counts across B25106 positive-income owner cost-burden bins, infer monthly debt service from bin income and burden midpoints, then convert payment to balance with a fixed-rate amortization formula.
revision_policy: recompute when ACS or Freddie Mac inputs update
methodological_notes: Proxy, not observed balance. Assumes income midpoints 10000, 27500, 42500, 62500, and 112500; cost-burden midpoints 0.10, 0.25, and 0.40; debt-service share of owner housing cost 0.80; remaining term 25 years; and Freddie Mac PMMS average rate over the ACS 5-year window.

display_name: ACS implied average mortgage balance proxy
definition: Aggregate implied mortgage debt proxy divided by ACS B25081 owner units with mortgage.
transformation: Aggregate implied mortgage debt proxy divided by ACS owner-with-mortgage count.
methodological_notes: Proxy average balance, not observed credit-bureau or servicing balance.

display_name: ACS implied annual mortgage debt service proxy
definition: Annualized mortgage debt-service proxy inferred from ACS B25106 owner cost-burden bins.
transformation: Sum allocated mortgaged units times inferred monthly debt-service payment times 12.
methodological_notes: Proxy excludes non-mortgage owner costs by applying the documented debt-service share assumption.

display_name: Mortgage debt proxy rate assumption
definition: Freddie Mac PMMS annual average rate used in the ACS implied mortgage-debt proxy.
transformation: Mean Freddie Mac monthly-average 30-year fixed rate over the ACS 5-year estimate window.
methodological_notes: Stored as an assumption column to make the proxy reproducible.

display_name: Mortgage debt proxy remaining-term assumption

methodological_notes: Stored as an assumption column to make the proxy reproducible.

display_name: Mortgage debt proxy debt-service-share assumption

transformation: Fixed 0.80 share applied to inferred owner housing cost.
methodological_notes: ACS owner housing costs include non-debt costs; this assumption excludes taxes, insurance, utilities, and fees approximately.

display_name: ACS implied aggregate home equity proxy

transformation: Subtract the B25106/B25081/Freddie implied aggregate mortgage debt proxy from owner-occupied units times ACS median home value.
methodological_notes: Proxy for the DOCX aggregate home-equity workaround; not an observed balance-sheet series.

methodological_notes: Timing allocation, not observed quarterly vital events; flagged imputed/interpolated in quarterly controls.

display_name: ZHVI Month-over-Month Growth
definition: Fractional change in ZHVI from the prior month
methodological_notes: Constructed from active SA ZHVI.

display_name: ZHVI Year-over-Year Growth
definition: Fractional change in ZHVI from twelve months earlier
methodological_notes: Constructed from active SA ZHVI.

display_name: ZORI Month-over-Month Growth
definition: Fractional change in SA ZORI from the prior month
methodological_notes: Constructed only from zori_smoothed_sa.

display_name: ZORI Year-over-Year Growth
definition: Fractional change in SA ZORI from twelve months earlier
methodological_notes: Constructed only from zori_smoothed_sa.

display_name: Active Inventory Month-over-Month Growth
definition: Fractional change in active for-sale inventory from the prior month
methodological_notes: For-sale inventory; not rental inventory.

display_name: Active Inventory Year-over-Year Growth
definition: Fractional change in active for-sale inventory from twelve months earlier
methodological_notes: For-sale inventory; not rental inventory.

display_name: Price-to-Rent Ratio
definition: ZHVI divided by twelve times monthly SA ZORI
missing_value_policy: require both components and nonzero rent
methodological_notes: Index valuation ratio; not a cap rate.

display_name: Inventory-to-Sales Ratio
definition: Active for-sale inventory divided by monthly homes sold
methodological_notes: Reciprocal orientation of sales-to-inventory and not housing-stock turnover.

display_name: Mortgage Payment with 10 Percent Down
definition: Monthly principal and interest on the county median sale price with 10 percent down
methodological_notes: Excludes tax insurance HOA maintenance and mortgage insurance.

display_name: Mortgage Payment with 20 Percent Down
definition: Monthly principal and interest on the county median sale price with 20 percent down
methodological_notes: Excludes tax insurance HOA maintenance and mortgage insurance.

display_name: Mortgage Payment-to-Rent with 10 Percent Down
definition: Constructed 10-percent-down principal-and-interest payment divided by monthly SA ZORI
methodological_notes: Payment scenario compared with an observed rent index.

display_name: Mortgage Payment-to-Rent with 20 Percent Down
definition: Constructed 20-percent-down principal-and-interest payment divided by monthly SA ZORI
methodological_notes: Payment scenario compared with an observed rent index.

display_name: Market Tightness Index
definition: Mean of available oriented z-scores for supply market-time inventory-growth and price-drop components
methodological_notes: Higher values indicate a tighter market; not an official provider statistic.

display_name: Market Tightness Component Count
definition: Number of nonmissing components entering the market tightness index
missing_value_policy: zero when no component is present
methodological_notes: Data-quality companion to market_tightness_index.

display_name: LA Metro Payroll Employment MoM Growth
definition: Fractional change in SA total nonfarm payroll employment from the prior month
methodological_notes: MSA control; not county LAUS employment.

display_name: LA Metro Payroll Employment YoY Growth
definition: Fractional change in SA total nonfarm payroll employment from twelve months earlier
methodological_notes: MSA control; not county LAUS employment.

display_name: LA Area CPI Inflation YoY
definition: Fractional change in LA-area CPI-U All Items NSA from twelve months earlier
methodological_notes: Uses current S49A series only.

display_name: California Personal Income QoQ Growth
definition: Fractional change in quarterly SAAR personal income from the prior quarter
methodological_notes: State control; not Los Angeles County income.

display_name: California Personal Income YoY Growth
definition: Fractional change in quarterly SAAR personal income from four quarters earlier
methodological_notes: State control; not Los Angeles County income.

display_name: LA County Personal Income Annual Growth
definition: Fractional change in annual county personal income from the prior year
methodological_notes: Remains annual and is not interpolated.

display_name: HVS Rental Vacancy YoY Change

methodological_notes: Sampling uncertainty remains in separate MOE columns.

display_name: FHFA HPI Year-over-Year Growth

methodological_notes: Method and geography remain explicit in the containing panel.

display_name: ZHVI December-to-December Growth

transformation: retain December and calculate annual change
methodological_notes: No partial-year value is labeled year-end.

display_name: FHFA-versus-Zillow Annual Growth Gap
definition: FHFA county annual HPI growth minus December-to-December county ZHVI growth
methodological_notes: Benchmark comparison only; the indexes have different methods and universes.

display_name: ACS total population benchmark

missing_value_policy: preserve published null or sentinel with flag
methodological_notes: Direct denominator for per-capita debt; no broader-geography substitute.

display_name: ACS aggregate selected monthly owner costs - mortgaged owners benchmark

display_name: ACS owner-occupied units benchmark

display_name: ACS mortgaged owner units benchmark

missing_value_policy: preserve published null or sentinel with flag
methodological_notes: Direct count; B25106 is not substituted.

display_name: ACS aggregate owner value - all owners benchmark

missing_value_policy: preserve published null or sentinel with flag
methodological_notes: Owner-occupied universe; published aggregate-dollar cells are retained unchanged after independent nearest-$100 rounding.

display_name: ACS aggregate owner value - mortgaged owners benchmark
definition: Published aggregate value of owner-occupied housing units with a mortgage
missing_value_policy: preserve published null or sentinel with flag
methodological_notes: Universe matched to first-mortgage debt construction; partition QA permits only the $100 discrepancy possible from independent Census rounding.

display_name: ACS aggregate owner value - mortgage-free owners benchmark
definition: Published aggregate value of owner-occupied housing units without a mortgage
missing_value_policy: preserve published null or sentinel with flag
methodological_notes: Added only to the all-owner equity measure; partition QA permits only the $100 discrepancy possible from independent Census rounding.

display_name: ACS aggregate household income - all owners benchmark

methodological_notes: Denominator for the mortgage debt-service-to-income benchmark; partition QA permits only the $100 discrepancy possible from independent Census rounding.

display_name: ACS aggregate household income - mortgage-free owners benchmark
definition: Published aggregate household income for owner-occupied housing units without a mortgage
missing_value_policy: preserve published null or sentinel with flag
methodological_notes: Retained for audit and comparison; partition QA permits only the $100 discrepancy possible from independent Census rounding.

display_name: PUMS first-mortgage P&I share source benchmark
definition: Selected county-target PUMS first-mortgage P&I share from the documented geography hierarchy
geography: complete county PUMA pool or connected regional PUMA pool or California fallback
transformation: pooled record-level WGTP-weighted P&I share with official SDR 90% MOE
missing_value_policy: preserve null below the sample threshold or when complete inputs are unavailable
revision_policy: archive each PUMS vintage and relationship file
methodological_notes: Direct source-parameter audit row; all 80 replicate weights are required when any are present; SMP is excluded from primary first-lien P&I.
source_geography: complete county PUMA pool or connected regional PUMA pool or California fallback

display_name: Applied PUMS first-mortgage P&I share benchmark
definition: Weighted share of selected monthly owner costs attributable to first-mortgage principal and interest
geography: complete county PUMA pool or connected regional PUMA pool or California fallback
transformation: record-level WGTP-pooled complete-case P&I share with official SDR 90% MOE
missing_value_policy: preserve missing; use a connected regional pool before a labeled California fallback
revision_policy: archive each PUMS vintage and relationship file
methodological_notes: Dual-PUMA releases are rejected unless Census publishes a verified single-vintage update; all 80 replicate weights are required when any are present; SMP is excluded from primary first-lien P&I.
source_geography: complete county PUMA pool or connected regional PUMA pool or California fallback

display_name: PUMS junior-lien monthly payment per mortgaged unit benchmark
definition: ADJHSG-adjusted WGTP-weighted SMP monthly payment per eligible owner-occupied first-mortgage PUMS unit
geography: complete county PUMA pool or connected regional PUMA pool or California fallback
transformation: record-level WGTP-weighted mean with official SDR 90% MOE and codebook-defined blank SMP as structural zero
missing_value_policy: preserve invalid reported inputs and expose record/weighted coverage diagnostics
revision_policy: archive each PUMS vintage and relationship file
methodological_notes: After TEN=1/MRGX=1 filtering blank SMP means no junior lien; all 80 replicate weights are required when any are present; payment-only diagnostic is never added to primary first-lien P&I or capitalized as debt and never used in equity.
source_geography: complete county PUMA pool or connected regional PUMA pool or California fallback

display_name: Estimated aggregate monthly first-mortgage P&I benchmark
definition: ACS aggregate selected owner costs multiplied by the source-period PUMS first-mortgage P&I share
missing_value_policy: preserve null when a required parameter is unavailable
methodological_notes: The word monthly describes the payment flow unit; the observation remains an ACS-period benchmark.

display_name: First-mortgage P&I per mortgaged unit benchmark
definition: Aggregate monthly first-mortgage P&I divided by directly published mortgaged owner units
methodological_notes: No monthly interpolation.

display_name: Annual first-mortgage debt service benchmark
definition: Twelve times aggregate monthly first-mortgage P&I
transformation: multiply monthly payment unit by twelve
methodological_notes: Annualized payment unit; not an annual point observation.

display_name: Mortgage debt-service-to-income benchmark
definition: Annualized first-mortgage P&I divided by matched mortgaged-owner aggregate household income
methodological_notes: Source-period benchmark rather than a monthly DSR.

display_name: Raw implied first-mortgage balance benchmark
definition: Fixed-rate-equivalent first-lien balance capitalized from aggregate P&I using a joint NMDB rate-term distribution or labeled PMMS term sensitivity
missing_value_policy: preserve null when a joint rate-term parameter is unavailable
methodological_notes: The distinct fhfa_nmdb_joint_distribution source is eligible only on an exact benchmark-vintage/reference-date match; PMMS remains a labeled origination-rate sensitivity fallback.

display_name: California-calibrated implied first-mortgage balance benchmark
definition: Raw county implied balance scaled to a compatible published California outstanding UPB total
transformation: ratio calibration across all California counties
missing_value_policy: null with calibration-unavailable flag when compatible California UPB is absent
methodological_notes: Requires a provenance-rich fhfa_nmdb_ca_upb row with explicit compatibility evidence and an exact benchmark-vintage/reference-date match; bare value mappings and raw-debt substitution are prohibited.

display_name: First-mortgage debt per mortgaged owner unit benchmark
definition: California-calibrated first-mortgage debt divided by directly published mortgaged owner units
missing_value_policy: preserve null when debt or denominator is unavailable or zero
methodological_notes: No broader-geography or temporal denominator substitute.

display_name: First-mortgage debt per owner unit benchmark

display_name: Implied mortgaged-owner home equity in constant 2024 dollars benchmark

original_field: nominal mortgaged-owner equity multiplied by CUUR0000SA0 M13 2024 divided by ACS ending-year M13

source_frequency: ACS 5-year plus NMDB period and annual CPI
